Adverse Effects: Oral ingestion of mistletoe may cause nausea, vomiting, hepatitis, hypotension, seizures, coma, or even death. Parenteral administration may result in chills, headache, angina, orthostatic hypotension, or allergic reactions. Hypersensitivity reactions are possible with oral ingestion. Important Note: This information pertains to European mistletoe. Do not confuse it with American mistletoe (Phoradendron spp.). Pregnancy and Lactation: Pregnancy Category: Not applicable. Lactation: Not applicable. Safety Classification: Generally acceptable. Controlled studies in pregnant women have shown no evidence of fetal risk.
